article.title: The Great Male Reset
article.excerpt: Men between the ages of 25 and 54 are in their prime working years. Generally speaking, they’re too old for college and too young for retirement. In February 2008, 87.4 percent of men in that demographic had jobs. Six years later, only 83.2 percent of men in that bracket are working. That is from Binyamin Appelbaum .
